newsitem.title: USA: R.P. Scherer gets topical patent.
newsitem.headline: R.P. Scherer gets topical patent.

text.p: R.P. Scherer Corp said Friday it won a U.S. patent covering stabilized ascorbic acid (Vitamin C) in a cosmetic cream using Scherer's softgel delivery system.
The company's invention relates to products for topical application to the skin and to stabilized emulsions containing water soluble active ingredients such as Vitamin C.

The emulsions are packaged in unit dose gelatin capsules which provide improved stability as well as purity of the compounds as compared with the more typical containers such as tubes and jars, R.P. Scherer said..
The company, a developer and manufacturer of advanced drug delivery systems, is a large producer of soft gelatin capsules.
